response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with 13+ years across web, mobile, desktop and some embedded work, and demonstrable strength in low-latency, event-driven, high-throughput systems (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic microservices, GISCollective platform). However, the role's core requirement is hands-on senior-level C++/STL development for industrial automation platforms, and his C++ exposure is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project — roughly a decade out of date. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL secure engineering, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), message-broker architecture at scale, or Azure. The gap on the primary technical and security competencies is too large to bridge for a mid-senior hire expected to mentor others on C++ and security standards.
strengths: Deep experience in high-performance, low-latency distributed/event-driven systems
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and public teaching
Broad polyglot background with proven ability to pick up new stacks quickly
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade stale
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, or OT protocol (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus) exposure
Career trajectory is web/full-stack (TypeScript/Node), not systems/embedded platform work

key_factors.factor: Distributed, concurrent, high-performance systems track record
